scope: Read-only second diagnosis of frozen e200 GRU_LOCAL, GRU_GRAPH and COND_ATTN; no training or experiment changes.
reference: Use existing h=1 model output. h=0 is outside the frozen public input contract and will not be queried.
decomposition: r0=y[n-1]-B[n-1]; c(h)=saved_mu(h)-B(h); shape(h)=c(h)-c(1). Evaluate B, B+r0, B+shape, B+r0+shape, and original B+c. The anchored shape holds the residual at r0 for h=1, so it omits the first day's residual increment. This is a mechanical diagnostic, not a trained boundary constraint.
teacher_support: All saved 200 batches, 4 origins and 16 distances per origin; preserve repetitions. Predefined teacher-age bins 0, 1-29, 30-89, >=90. No resampling or weight adjustment.
teacher_factorial: At each origin use the existing overlap with the preceding saved teacher: swap all physical history/query features and historical residual features as two separate factors. Observed displacement, preprocessing, weights and future forcing stay fixed. Mixed inputs are sensitivity diagnostics, not operational candidates.
selection: Report every predefined variant, seed, point and full window. No model or checkpoint selection.
probability: No new calibration or probability scores; original probability results remain frozen.
limits: Post-hoc exposed and overlapping dates. Attribution is algebraic/model dependence, not identification of a unique failure cause or validation of a fix.
